**Mainframe Batch Software**

This software represents a complete payroll cycle from the individual punch files to the final merges
of the hours worked, overtime and other components.

Description of each program:
* check_data.py - This file was designed to quickly inspect the binary data generated by the various programs.
* daily_sorter.py = This program sorts the employee data so that it is organized appropriately
* employee_compiler.py = This program is an early version of the pgroam used to compile the baseline emplyoees
* employee_record.c - This program geneates random employee records in a custom binary format
* fakepunchgenerator.py - This program generates fake employee punches into the binary format
* final_report.txt - A sample final report after the entire prokect has run broken down
* payroll_calculator - This software merges the payroll for the week and the employee files, generating a report
* punch_sorter - Manages the randomly set punch files into organized files using an external sort
* punchrecord.c - Uses C tot generate a punch record.
* report_generator.py - Generates a finished payroll record
* shift_merger.py - Merges the shifts of the employees based on punches
* week_compiler.py - Compiles the individual work days into a week binary file with merged data
* week_compiler_alpha.py - Early version of the week compiler for testing purposes.
